reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the sachet size and the $29.99 for 30 days, so about a dollar a day with free shipping, and a sachet fits in my tote next to the charger and snacks. The lab QR code is a nice touch, but honestly I would wait for a flash sale or coupon before I tap buy.
objection: Two capsules a day, and size 00 capsules are big, I already struggle to swallow big pills. A new brand I have never heard of, so I would buy one box first and not a stack.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon bringing it to about $22 to $24, or a smaller trial box so I can check the capsules go down easily.
